body:
This hurts a bit to say, because you've clearly put a lot of time into this PR, but we're going to have to close it. 

While you _have_ [opened a proposal](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/10132) for the feature, according to our expected workflow, you have ignored the outcome of the proposal, which is that there seems to be almost no community demand for it (~5 upvotes in two years, and almost no discussion). We cannot merge new features like this to the GDScript language without proven need or demand.

Still: while we're closing the PR, we're not rejecting the feature right now. If community demand emerges, we can reconsider our stance on a PR for it.
